title: Basic and diluted EPS — Northgate Industries
instructions: Northgate Industries is a public company with a calendar year-end. Compute its Year 2 EPS using the exhibits. Round per-share amounts to two decimals; round share counts to whole shares.

exhibits.title: Common share activity, Year 2
exhibits.content:
| Date | Event |
|---|---|
| Jan 1 | 150,000 shares outstanding |
| Mar 1 | Issued 30,000 shares for cash |
| Jun 30 | Distributed a 10% stock dividend |
| Nov 1 | Purchased 12,000 shares of treasury stock |

exhibits.title: Other information
exhibits.content:
- Net income: **$800,000**. Tax rate: **25%**.
- Preferred stock: 5% **noncumulative**, $500,000 par, **not convertible**; the Year 2 dividend was declared.
- Employee stock options: **15,000** shares at an exercise price of **$40**, outstanding all year.
- Warrants: **8,000** shares at **$65**, outstanding all year.
- 4% convertible bonds, face **$2,000,000**, issued at par in Year 1, convertible into **20,000** common shares.
- Average market price of common stock in Year 2: **$60**.

rows.label: Weighted-average common shares for basic EPS
Incremental shares from employee stock options
Amount added to the numerator for the convertible bonds

parts.prompt: Indicate the treatment of each item in computing Year 2 diluted EPS.

rows.label: Warrants ($65 exercise)
rows.explanation: Exercise price $65 exceeds the $60 average price → out of the money.

rows.label: 4% convertible bonds
rows.explanation: Incremental EPS $3.00 is below basic EPS and below EPS after options ($3.96).

rows.label: June 30 stock dividend
rows.explanation: Stock dividends restate shares as of the beginning of the period — not time-weighted.
